title: Append a conversation turn
summary: Append one reply to the conversation you read.
purpose: Append one reply to the conversation you read.
request: {{route:conversation.turn}}. Send `body` with `based_on_seq` set to the `head_seq` from your last read. See `conversation/encoding` for transport and `attachments/link` for file links. Supply a one-line English `commit_message` when the worktree has uncommitted changes.
response: Turns are stored in order. `dry_run: true` checks links and encoding without registering a turn or consuming the token.
errors: For `422 commit_message_required`, supply the message and retry. See the linked help for attachment and encoding errors.
